locator.section: 8.11 Other rearrangements -- 'EE+ ions can also undergo such group migrations with elimination' (Eqs 8.117-8.120)

evidence.curator_note: ARCS ACTUALLY DRAWN: ZERO. Equation 8.118 (attributed on the page to Wood et al. 1992) shows only the bracketed radical cation, an arrow labelled 're', and the product ion; no curved arrow, fishhook or neutral product is printed. Every one of the twelve moves encoded here is therefore curator-constructed. SUBSTRATE READ FROM THE DRAWING: C6H5SO2- on a quaternary carbon that also carries Si(CH3)3, a -CH2CH2C6H5 branch and a chain of six CH2 groups (counted vertex by vertex on the zoomed scan) running to a thioether S, then -CH2CH2Si(CH3)3; C29H48O2S2Si2, M+. m/z 548.26. PRODUCT READ FROM THE DRAWING: C6H5-S(+)(OSi(CH3)3)2 -- both trimethylsilyl groups have moved onto the two sulfonyl oxygens and the S-C bond has gone; C12H23O2SSi2+, m/z 287.10. WHAT IS CURATOR-ASSIGNED AND WHY: (i) the ionisation site. The book brackets the whole ion with '+.'; convention B requires it localised, and it is placed on one sulfonyl oxygen (n-ionisation), which is the oxygen that then captures the first silyl group. (ii) The neutral, which the book does not draw at all. Removing both silyl groups and the S-C bond leaves THREE open valences (two on the quaternary carbon, one on the silyl-bearing terminal CH2); spin conservation forbids leaving them as a triradical (a doublet ion cannot give a doublet ion plus a quartet neutral), so two of them are paired here as a new C-C bond, giving a ten-membered thioether ring carrying the phenethyl group and one unpaired electron (C17H25S., 261.17). Any other pairing (e.g. a 1,2-H shift to give an alkene plus a terminal radical) balances equally well; the ring was chosen because it needs no additional hydrogen migration. The neutral is an inference, not a reading of the page.

NO MØD RULE IS CROSS-LINKED, and this was CHECKED, not assumed (convention E). rule_index.json 'by_equation' has no '8.118' key at all -- its chapter-8 index runs 8.1-8.14 only (German-edition numbering), so nothing in src/data_generation/rules/ is authored for this equation. As for 8.117, no rule pattern in the set contains silicon, so no silyl migration can be matched; in addition no rule in the set forms a new carbon-carbon bond between two remote radical sites.

evidence.curator_note: NO MEASUREMENT ON THE PAGE (convention F): Equation 8.118 prints no m/z and no abundance. m/z 287.0953 is the curator-computed monoisotopic mass of the drawn product ion C12H23O2SSi2+, and the precursor m/z 548.2629 in ms_context is likewise computed from the transcribed structure -- it depends on the chain length read off the drawing (six CH2 between the quaternary carbon and the thioether sulfur). Status 'inferred', detected=false, no relative_intensity. MS-CONTEXT ASSUMPTION (disclosed): ms_context.activation_method '70 eV EI' and electron_energy_ev 70.0 are the Chapter-8 house default, NOT printed on this page -- the page names no ionisation or activation conditions. Only the ion type (the drawn '+.' / '+') is source-backed. BOOK'S PROSE vs ITS OWN DRAWING (disclosed): the sentence introducing this block calls Equations 8.117-8.120 examples of 'EE+ ions', yet eq 8.118's substrate is drawn inside a bracket closed with '+.' (verified at 9x on the native scan of printed p. 219) -- an ODD-electron molecular ion. The record follows the DRAWING (charge 1 + radical 1, adduct [M]+.), not the prose.
